exposure: Initial plan of management on admission (TOLAC, EMCD, RCD)
Women with one prior cesarean delivery
cohort: 1247 women with one prior CD who delivered at Korle-Bu Teaching Hospital (KBTH), Ghana
finding: Women triaged to EMCD experienced higher rates of both maternal and perinatal adverse outcomes compared to those triaged to TOLAC or RCD.
mod_finding: The study specifically focuses on the mode of delivery after a previous cesarean section.
